verdict.rationale: The privacy policy names an official Mac OS app alongside the mobile apps, and the homepage says Instinct connects to your 'screen', so a first-party desktop app with screen access is claimed. However, the evidence never mentions OS-level shortcuts or hotkeys. The homepage also stresses there are 'no new interfaces' and that users text or call the agent, which suggests the desktop app is not the main interaction surface. Missing for 10: any evidence of OS-level or global keyboard shortcuts, documentation of how screen access works in the desktop app, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the Mac app.
